---
title: "Indicators"
execute:
  echo: false
---

Explore the indicators collected by the AHEAD project. Use the search box or column filters to find resources by name, category or keyword.


```{r}
library(data.table)
library(rjson)
library(reactable)

indicators_dir <- "../indicators/"

fls <- list.files(
  indicators_dir,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "\\.json$"
)

indicators_dt <- lapply(fls, function(file) {

  json_data <- file |>
    readLines(warn = FALSE) |>
    paste(collapse = "") |>
    fromJSON()

  json_data$keywords <- paste(
    json_data$keywords,
    collapse = ", "
  )

  json_data
}) |>
  rbindlist(
    idcol = "id",
    use.names = TRUE,
    fill = TRUE
  )

reactable(
  indicators_dt,

  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = FALSE,

  defaultPageSize = 10,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 25, 50, 100),

  paginationType = "jump",

  defaultColDef = colDef(
    resizable = TRUE,
    minWidth = 120,
    headerStyle = list(
      background = "#5544cc",
      color = "white",
      fontWeight = "600",
      borderBottom = "none"
    ),
    style = list(
      padding = "12px",
      whiteSpace = "normal",
      lineHeight = "1.4"
    )
  ),

  columns = list(
    id = colDef(
      name = "ID",
      width = 70,
      align = "center"
    ),

    keywords = colDef(
      name = "Keywords",
      minWidth = 220,
      style = list(
        color = "#5544cc",
        fontSize = "0.85rem"
      )
    )
  ),

  theme = reactableTheme(
    borderColor = "#e5e5e5",

    stripedColor = "#f8f7ff",
    highlightColor = "#eeeaff",

    cellPadding = "10px 12px",

    style = list(
      fontFamily = "Comfortaa, sans-serif",
      fontSize = "0.9rem"
    ),

    searchInputStyle = list(
      border = "1px solid #d6d2ee",
      borderRadius = "6px",
      padding = "8px 12px"
    ),

    selectStyle = list(
      border = "1px solid #d6d2ee",
      borderRadius = "6px"
    )
  )
)
```
